meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或更新扩展能力的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想为助手添加自定义知识或工作流
copy.tagline_en: Create or update skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add custom knowledge or workflows to your assistant

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个技能创建向导，指导你一步步设计、编写和打包技能，包括规划脚本、引用文件和资源，并遵循渐进式披露原则来节省上下文窗口。
howto.when: 当你说要创建新技能或更新现有技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 PDF 处理技能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成技能创建流程。

say.text: 我想更新我的 BigQuery 技能，添加新的表结构。
say.note: Claude 会指导你编辑现有技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a skill creation guide, helping you design, write, and package skills step by step, including planning scripts, references, and assets, following progressive disclosure to save context window.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you want to create a new skill or update an existing one.

say_en.text: Help me create a PDF processing skill.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the skill creation process.

say_en.text: I want to update my BigQuery skill with new table schemas.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through editing the existing skill.
